content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked details about several upcoming Apple home products, including a new-generation HomePod mini, a security camera, a new Siri remote for use with the new Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad product.

After digging deeper into this code, there appear to be important clues about the HomePad's design direction...

According to Engadget's Filipe Espósito, the HomePad, while likely running some version of tvOS, may operate more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a privacy-focused practical feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on its widget when it detects your iPhone nearby.

The HomePad is expected to come in two versions, one with a speaker base that may resemble the HomePod in appearance; the other designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products mentioned above, other unknown devices were also mentioned. Honestly, I'm really hoping one of them is a smart doorbell. Which Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to leave a comment and share your thoughts.
